defect: Adding '&& depal' makes SetDepalTexture(VK_NULL_HANDLE) a no-op, so boundDepal_ is never cleared and later non-depal draws keep a stale depal image view bound (and the fragment shader state is not dirtied).
reason: The fix backs out exactly this condition; callers in TextureCacheVulkan pass VK_NULL_HANDLE to unbind, which the added check silently ignores.

defect: The fix passes the host copy param_argp instead of the PSP address param.argp to __KernelStartModule; that mismatch was created by the intermediate commit f528774, which introduced param_argp but left the call unchanged.
reason: In this change param.argp was replaced by the host buffer, so passing param.argp was correct here; the bug came from the later f528774 refactor.

defect: The new FRound, FCeil and FFloor interpreter cases write the integer result to mips->r[dest] (GPR) instead of mips->fs[dest] (FPR).
reason: The fix changes exactly these added lines to fs[], and the adjacent FTrunc case in the same diff already writes fs[], so the inconsistency is visible.

defect: The fix restructures UnsyncKey so gamepad input still reaches the control mapper while the ImGui debugger is shown; the change only replaced imguiVisible_ with g_Config.bShowImDebugger.
reason: The blocking of gamepad input while ImGui is visible existed before this change, which was a pure state-to-config rename.

defect: The fix makes ProcessKeyboardShortcuts return unless the disassembly view is focused, so shortcuts no longer fire while typing in other ImGui windows.
reason: Keys were already processed without a focus check before this change (PageUp/PageDown in Draw), the harmful arrow/Ctrl shortcuts came from the later 6b11ebf, and the X key added here called a stub that did nothing.

defect: The fix removes the bAnisotropicFiltering field, which by then had no users, as cleanup after a merge.
reason: Deleting an unused declaration repairs no behaviour; the field was used consistently in Config.cpp and MenuScreens.cpp when added.

defect: The fix only changes the memory-type log output (shorter flag names, skipping types with no flags); the SDL build breakage it names was in SDLVulkanGraphicsContext.cpp.
reason: The changes to this file are cosmetic logging edits, not a defect repair.

defect: EndFrame dereferences shaderInfo->isUpscalingFilter without checking that GetPostShaderInfo found the shader, so a post-shader name other than Off that is not found (empty in headless) crashes.
reason: The fix adds the null check to exactly the lines this change added; GetPostShaderInfo in PostShader.cpp returns 0 for unknown names.

defect: The moved Rotation popup passes the Graphics category (gr->GetName()) for its choice strings, but Landscape/Portrait are translated under Controls, so the choices are no longer translated.
reason: The removed code in GameSettingsScreen.cpp used co->GetName(), and the fix restores the Controls category on exactly the line this change added.

defect: readIndexedTex used the level-0 texture width and height for every mip level; the fix passes the level.
reason: Before this change getTextureWidth() already returned the level-0 size, so writing getTextureWidth(0) kept the existing behaviour and did not introduce the bug.

defect: Registering LoadExecForKernel and SysMemForKernel in the middle of RegisterAllModules shifts the indices of all later modules, which breaks savestates made before the change.
reason: The fix moves exactly these two added registration calls to the end; seeing that module indices are baked into savestates requires the HLE syscall code.

defect: In this file the fix only renames the enum values GEN_ARG_U_PTR/V_PTR to GEN_ARG_TEXPTR_PTR/BUFW_PTR; the wrong mip-level bufw is in SamplerX86.cpp code added later.
reason: This change only refactored nearest sampling and added enum values; the base-bufw-for-level-1 bug came from the later cdf14c8.

defect: The new Jit_PrepareData*Offsets signatures take no level, so the offsets computed for the second mip level (U1/V1) use the level-0 bufw.
reason: This commit added the level-1 offset computation through these functions, which read bufw[0]; the fix adds a level1 parameter to these declarations, and the defect shows only in SamplerX86.cpp.

defect: The fix makes the linear sampler read bufw at offset level1 instead of always bufw[0] when preparing data offsets.
reason: At this change the linear function was still called once per level with the array already advanced to that level, so bufw[0] was correct; reusing it for level 1 came with the later cdf14c8.

defect: The new EI_CLASS check rejects ELFs whose class byte is 0 (as produced by emulator-only patches) that loaded before, so those games no longer start.
reason: The fix relaxes exactly this added check to log and continue for EI_CLASS 0, which repairs a compatibility regression the change caused; that such files exist is not visible from code.

defect: In this file the fix only changes brace style and adds comments; the ESC-return bug is fixed in other files.
reason: The header lines this change added (UIScreen base, CreateViews) are not repaired by the fix.

defect: The fix routes Continue through UIScreen::OnBack and moves gpu->Resized into onFinish so that ESC/back also resizes; this change only made strings translatable.
reason: The Continue handler and the missing resize on back already existed before this change.

defect: The fix changes GamePauseScreen to derive from UIDialogScreen and adds onFinish; this change only initialized saveSlots_ to NULL.
reason: The fix touches the constructor line only to change the base class, which is a redesign for back-button handling, not a defect from this change.

defect: Comp_VDot fetches dregs with the source vector size (GetVectorRegs(dregs, sz, vd)) though vdot writes a single value, and the new constant zero is defined as -1.0f.
reason: The fix changes dregs to V_Single and stops using the wrong zero constant, both added by this change; the mismatch with MapRegsV(dregs, V_Single) and zero = -1.0f are visible in the diff.

defect: The fix changes [&] to [=] in SetEnabledFunc lambdas that call the local lambda enableStereo, which would otherwise dangle after CreateViews returns.
reason: In this change those [&] lambdas only used the member enableStereo_ through this, which is safe; the dangling capture came from 1da6d29, which replaced the member with a local lambda.

defect: The fix makes sceMp3Decode decode one frame per call, fixes the stream buffer address and loop handling, and adjusts log levels.
reason: None of the repaired logic lies in this change's lines (zero-initialization, bigger log buffer, commented-out allocation); the decode loop and buffer handling predate it.

defect: The fix swaps nickname and bssid in SceNetAdhocctlParameter and updates a comment on flags.
reason: SceNetAdhocctlParameter was unchanged context in this change; its field order was wrong before.

defect: The fix removes the EGL/egl.h include from the GLES path entirely to avoid X11 namespace pollution.
reason: The include was unconditional before this change, which only excluded it on Maemo/Meego, so the pollution on other GLES platforms predates it.

defect: The fix lowers GAMEMODE_UPDATE_INTERVAL from 10000 to 500 and adds GAMEMODE_INIT_DELAY.
reason: This is performance tuning of a constant together with a new delay, not the repair of a defect in this change.

defect: The fix renames the non-Windows TimeSpan method definitions to Instant to match the class rename.
reason: The class was renamed to Instant by the intermediate commit 96c4ae4, which updated only the Windows definitions, so that commit broke the non-Windows build, not this one.

defect: The fix replaces the Buffer used to build the FPS text with a stack StringWriter; the FPS display regression was an inverted PSP_IsInited check in EmuScreen.cpp.
reason: The Buffer-based formatting from this change works correctly; the regression came from a later EmuScreen.cpp change (2025-03-28), and the DebugOverlay part of the fix is a refactor.

defect: The fix makes the name/encoding fields const char * and the encoding fields unsigned to silence conversion warnings.
reason: Warning-only type cleanup; nothing in behaviour is repaired.

defect: FragmentShaderDesc reports ReplaceLogic for clear-mode shader IDs, because clear IDs leave the logic-op bits 0, which differs from GE_LOGIC_COPY.
reason: The fix adds the clear-mode exclusion to exactly the line this change added; seeing it requires knowing GE_LOGIC_COPY is nonzero.

defect: In this file the fix only moves a blank line around the invariant gl_Position declaration.
reason: Whitespace-only change; no defect is repaired here.

defect: The condition module_start_func != 0 || module_start_func != -1 is always true, so the start-function checks and warnings run even when there is no start function.
reason: The fix replaces || with && on exactly the line this change added, and the tautology is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix casts shiftAmount to u32 in the VSHLL comparison to silence a signed/unsigned warning.
reason: Warning-only change; the comparison behaves the same for valid shift amounts.

defect: __SasDoState calls RestoreRegisterEvent with sasMixEvent even when the restored value is -1 (old savestate loaded and then resaved), which crashes on load.
reason: The fix guards exactly this added RestoreRegisterEvent call; the diff itself sets sasMixEvent = -1 for old states and treats -1 as no event in delaySasResult.

defect: The fix guards onPaint against functions.find() returning end() and limits function branch lines to targets inside the function.
reason: In this change scanFunctions inserted every address it put into visibleFunctionAddresses, so the find could not fail; the crash became reachable through d56ade5's clearFunctions, and the in-function filter is a display refinement.

defect: The new clearFunctions() clears the functions map but leaves visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines, so onPaint later dereferences functions.end() for a stale address and crashes.
reason: The fix makes clearFunctions also clear visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines; the unchecked dereference that crashes is in CtrlDisAsmView.cpp.

defect: In this file the fix rearranges texture flush/rebind calls in GameButton::Draw; the UNKNOWN.PNG bug it names is fixed in GameInfoCache.cpp.
reason: The render-state edits are cleanup (the else branch was unreachable because Draw returns without a texture), not a defect from this change.

defect: The fix moves vCount++ from hleLeaveVblank to hleEnterVblank and adds the hcount value to the debug log.
reason: vCount++ in hleLeaveVblank was unchanged context in this change, and the hcount computation it added is left unchanged by the fix.

defect: The fix defers savestate processing until Init when the kernel is not running yet, so --state loads on startup.
reason: The --state option (14ef840) and the breakage the fix names (883f61e) came after this change; the ScheduleEvent_Threadsafe path already existed before it.

defect: A debugging 'return 0;' at the top of PSPSaveDialog::Init makes the whole save dialog initialization unreachable, so savedata dialogs do nothing.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added line, and the dead code after it is obvious in the diff.

defect: The fix changes memStickInsertedAt from s64 to u64 to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: Warning-only change; tick values are non-negative so the comparison result is unchanged.

defect: CheckBox::Toggled() returns the pointer toggle_ (always true when set) instead of *toggle_, so every checkbox draws as checked.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added return to *toggle_, and the missing dereference is visible in the diff.
